bracket_stock.interpretation: Inferred Z-bracket stock. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

bracket_width.interpretation: Longitudinal width. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

bracket_forward_offset.interpretation: Center forward of casing cap seam. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

bracket_web_axis_offset.interpretation: Web base below roller-pinion axis. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

case_leg_height.interpretation: Case attachment leg height above web base. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

hull_leg_drop.interpretation: Hull attachment leg below web base. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

case_rivet_end.interpretation: Rivet distance from longitudinal edge. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

case_rivet_vertical_end.interpretation: Rivet offset from top/bottom of case leg. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

hull_bolt_halfpitch.interpretation: Half spacing of two inferred hull bolts. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

hole_diameter_clearance.interpretation: Clearance above nominal shank diameter. Bounds are uncertainty, not a qualified range.

bolt_length.interpretation: Select documented SNL31:007 standard length for this unlocated joint; applicability is not source-confirmed.

fastener_shape_controls: Reuse casing_cap_controls.json for nominal half-inch diameter, head/nut/washer envelopes; override bolt length to38.1mm.
quantity_interpretation: Four brackets,28case rivets and8assumed three-part hull fastener sets. Bracket identities and rivet joint allocations are sourced; hull bolt size/count/placement are inferred.
hand_interpretation: Right M1587 assigned negative localY; left M1588 positive localY. Existing frame-clearance datums set their receiver planes.
